title: DOH PROVIDES UPDATE ON SPOILED FOOD REMOVAL AT HAPPY DAYS RESTAURANT
summary: HONOLULU — The Hawai‘i Department of Health (DOH) and the City and County of Honolulu Department of Planning and Permitting (DPP) are providing an update on efforts to remove spoiled food and control pests at the closed Happy Days Chinese Seafood Restaurant in Kaimukī, following the partial roof collapse at the restaurant last month.
